content.title: Browse bouquet catalogue and view bouquet prices before adding to the basket
content.intent: Prove that a visitor can browse bouquet listings and see each bouquet's price before taking any basket action, including on a phone-sized browser.
content.technique_notes: Derived with equivalence partitioning over viewport classes for the same expected outcome: default browser and phone-sized browser. covering_array reported strength=1 (degraded from 2: only 1 input(s))), so the scenario enumerates the single input's representative values as parameters rather than splitting outcome-identical paths. Responsiveness was included because the source explicitly says the flow must work on a phone; negative, BVA, a11y, perf, and i18n did not mint separate paths because the source states no invalid-input behavior, bounds, accessibility promise, performance threshold, or locale-dependent rule for catalogue browsing.
